title: LinkedIn and Portfolio Alignment
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting linkedin and portfolio alignment to resume before-after revision with truthful evidence, role fit, and AI-use note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Run a cross-platform alignment audit (inventory, detect, reconcile, diff) on one role across resume, LinkedIn, and portfolio, anchoring to the truthful version.
Identify the four anchors (display name, current title or role, dates, headline accomplishment) and verify they do not contradict across platforms.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the artifact before sharing it.
